annotations.title: Freeze, unfreeze and seizure history of programmable tokens

description: What issuers of programmable tokens (CIP-113) have done, each with its transaction: wallets put on or taken off a block list (`freeze`, `unfreeze`), tokens moved out of a wallet by the issuer without the holder's signature (`third_party`: a seizure or forced transfer), mints and burns, pauses and other setting changes (`state_changed`), rule changes, new operators, registrations. Filter by token, by kind or by the wallet credential concerned. An empty list means none are indexed in the period the `coverage` field names, not that none happened before it.

credential.description: Only events about this owner credential (56 hex): frozen, taken from, or given tokens.

kind.description: Only this kind of event. freeze/unfreeze = block-list changes; third_party = tokens moved by the issuer without the holder.

limit.description: How many events to return (1-100, default 25).

token.description: Only events of this token: policy id or unit.

name: list_programmable_events
